newsitem.title: CANADA: Potash starts offer for Arcadian debt.
newsitem.headline: Potash starts offer for Arcadian debt.

text.p: Potash Corp of Saskatchewan Inc said on Thursday it launched its cash offer for senior notes of Arcadian Corp subsidiaries in connection with its proposed merger with nitrogen fertilizer producer Arcadian.
Potash Corp said the tender offer was for all outstanding 10.75 percent senior notes due 2005 of Arcadian Partners LP and Arcadian Partners Finance Corp.
The offer was to expire at 1700 EST (2200 GMT) on Thursday, March 6, unless extended or terminated.
Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp was dealer manager for the tender offer, it said.
